t: This is Westminster Kitchen, a restaurant. It was owned by Ibrahim Dogus, a British Kurdish politician, entrepreneur and restaurateur, born in Turkey. He founded SME4Labour, the Centre for Turkey Studies and the Centre for Kurdish Progress. He served as a Labour councillor in Lambeth, and stood as the Labour candidate for the Cities of London and Westminster in the 2017 general election. So the person behind this restaurant has a background in community organising and politics as well as food.
